answer: Peer attestations, recorded crystal-clear on-chain, gate payouts, so fake accounts collapse under their own multiplied costs. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit that decays like shale eroding under pressure: honest work keeps it intact, but sybil identities split the stake across many keys, driving each share toward a nadir where rewards no longer cover gas and bond risk. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
